push.title: L 0-4 vs Gurjots Army | You: 7.8
push.body:
Good stuff, BellyTb1. A 7.8 against Gurjots Army. Not fireworks, but a nice warm campfire.

THE GOOD
+ 26 passes (up from your usual 17). You made yourself big and available, and it paid off.
+ Better tackles won than any of their humans (1 vs their best 0). Little things like that are big things in disguise.
+ 3rd straight match at 7.5 match rating. Keep stacking those bricks.

THE BAD
- No key passes from 26 passes. Keep this in your pocket: Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side. Practice makes permanent.
- Shot accuracy 0%, down from your usual 81%. We can fix that.
- We shipped 4 goals to Gurjots Army and lost by 4. We'll talk about it as a group, then leave it behind us.
- 4 goals conceded took 0.1. Head up first, then play.
- Their humans averaged 8.8 to our 7.4; we were second best man for man. That's the scoreboard being honest with us.

Training ground: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.

BellyTb1, something I want you to sleep on: Win the next five seconds, then the next five.

Good effort, better days ahead. - Coach Lasso
